name: Shorecraft
description: Construct Stone ports. Port access alone creates no military vessel, sea trader, or passive trade income.

name: Cargo Canoes
description: Unlock automatic shore embarkation in free temporary transports carrying 10 whole squads. Move orders cross reachable water and resume on land; transports disappear after landing. Also unlock port-built permanent transports and automatic water trade from factories through reachable ports. Water trade does not require Goods Handling.

name: War Canoes
description: Stone warship definition for local escort/interception. Keep its combat stats independent of the transport.

name: Coastal Navigation
description: Improve Stone sailing and embark/disembark handling under authored values; complete Naval. Does not bypass coast/reachability rules.

name: Flint Weapons
description: Stone barracks and clubmen/Flint infantry. No manufactured-weapon requirement.

name: Spear Throwing
description: Stone ranged camp and javelinists. Ranged damage, range, and reload define this role. No manufactured weapons.

name: Horsemanship
description: Horse-node exploitation, slow stable breeding, Stone stables and mounted spearmen. Recruitment costs reserves and horses. Proposed first charge-capable definition.

name: Field Engineering
description: Wooden towers and linked palisades use Art/Terrain/Wall Kit/Palisades; gate capability, Stone field-siege production and battering ram. Siege breaches independently of infantry. Gate and Stone siege art remain outstanding.

name: Settlements
description: Stone cities and their reserve-production capability. No free city appears at match start.

name: Craft Workshops
description: Construct workshops/factories and stock commercial goods. Overland deliveries require Goods Handling; water deliveries require Cargo Canoes and a reachable port.

name: Stone Mining
description: Stone mine construction and stone extraction. No Horsemanship prerequisite; Stone mine art is missing.

name: Goods Handling
description: Unlock automatic overland traders with finite multi-stop factory loads and increased cargo capacity. Gold is paid on delivery at cities and ports. Water trade is unlocked separately by Cargo Canoes.

name: Planked Hulls
description: Bronze port/shipbuilding tier and Bronze military transport definition. Enables the new hull tier; does not refit old ships automatically. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Merchant Sailing
description: Bronze trade-ship definition and sailing/cargo capability. Dispatch remains automatic, free, bounded, and dependent on real factory cargo.

name: Oared Warships
description: Bronze oared warship definition, using the galley-like art. Escort and interception are baseline military uses.

name: Naval Organisation
description: Better loading/transport capacity and coordinated naval handling. No sharing of allied units or inventory is implied.

name: Bronze Equipment
description: Bronze blacksmith, barracks tier and bronze swordsmen. Manufacture shared Bronze Age equipment for infantry, archers and chariots. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Bowcraft
description: Bronze archery range and archers. Uses the same Bronze Age equipment as other Bronze troops. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Chariot Warfare
description: Bronze stables and chariots. Recruitment uses shared Bronze Age equipment, horses and reserves. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Fortified Settlements
description: Stone walls and round stone towers use Art/Terrain/Wall Kit/StoneWalls; gate capability, Bronze siege workshop, reinforced ram and siege-equipment pattern. Battering-ram and assault siege-tower art exists; assault/bridge behaviour needs its own contract. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Armies
description: Organize up to 20 existing squad formations into a persistent army. Cohesive marching columns, role-based deployment, flank and fire-and-retreat orders, optional automatic tactics. Later Warfare foundations raise capacity to 25, 30, 35, 40 and 50. No free troops or equipment.

name: Bronze Metallurgy
description: Additional raw mining and alloy refining to bronze; Bronze mine/factory processing tier. Bronze is manufactured, not a deposit.

name: Urban Workshops
description: Bronze city/commercial workshop tier, handcart merchant definition, and improved commercial output.

name: Road Networks
description: Packed-dirt trade-road tier and researched route movement/handling improvement. Physical road authoring/placement policy remains open.

name: Civic Administration
description: Higher delivery capacity and city reserve administration. No separate market/town-hall building is required.

name: Shipyards
description: Classical port and hull-production tier. No extra standalone shipyard art/building is assumed. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Transport Fleets
description: Classical transport and trade-ship definitions, with larger authored troop/cargo capacity.

name: Galley Warfare
description: Classical galley warship definition; combat/escort capability appropriate to its oared art.

name: Naval Logistics
description: Improved naval load handling and delivery turnaround; maintain cargo conservation and actual arrival payments.

name: Professional Infantry
description: Classical blacksmith and barracks, sword-and-shield infantry and improved protection. Manufacture shared Classical Age equipment from iron. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Ranged Warfare
description: Classical archers use shared Classical Age equipment. Mangonels and Onagers use shared Classical Age siege equipment, while retaining distinct research and combat profiles. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Cavalry Tactics
description: Classical stables and mounted swordsmen. Recruitment uses shared Classical Age equipment, horses and reserves. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Masonry Engineering
description: Massive stone walls and square bastions use Art/Terrain/Wall Kit/MassiveStoneWalls; gate capability, Classical siege facility and heavy Onager equipment/definition, distinct from Mangonel field support. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Ironworking
description: Iron-ore extraction and iron refining; Classical mine/factory processing tier.

name: Urban Planning
description: Classical city/workshop tier and improved commercial production/urban reserves.

name: Caravan Roads
description: Compacted-gravel road tier and Classical merchant party: mule wagon plus pack donkey. Larger finite load and researched route efficiency.

name: Husbandry
description: Improved horse breeding at eligible owned stables and better logistical handling. Research can complete without owning a stable.

name: Framed Hulls
description: Early Medieval port and stronger hull-production tier. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Seafaring
description: Early Medieval transport/trade ships and improved sailing performance.

name: Coastal Warships
description: Early Medieval oared/sailing warship definition. Raiding is a use of military orders, not a new automatic gold generator.

name: Landing Logistics
description: More efficient legal landing/embarkation and naval cargo handling.

name: Mail Equipment
description: Early Medieval blacksmith and barracks, mail infantry and shared Early Medieval equipment manufactured from iron. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Bow and Bolt Warfare
description: Bowmen use shared Early Medieval equipment. Ballistas and Trebuchets use shared Early Medieval siege equipment, with separate recruitment research. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Mounted Spearmen
description: Early Medieval stables and mounted spearmen. Recruitment uses shared Early Medieval equipment, horses and reserves. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Trebuchet Engineering
description: Improved masonry walls/towers/gates, Early Medieval siege workshop and Trebuchet equipment/definition. The current wall kit ends at Classical; a distinct Early Medieval visual tier is not verified. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Agricultural Organisation
description: Early Medieval city/mine operating tier, improved reserve generation and extraction efficiency. No separate farm building is implied by this technology name.

name: Craft Guilds
description: Early Medieval workshop/factory tier and higher commercial/refining production efficiency through separate jobs.

name: Caravan Breeding
description: Two-wagon horse caravan, rough-stone roads, and another stable breeding improvement. Commercial mounts do not charge the military horse inventory.

name: Market Logistics
description: Larger funded multi-stop loads and shorter handling delays; improve throughput before increasing actor caps.

name: Sailing Hulls
description: Late Medieval port and sailing-hull production tier. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Merchant Convoys
description: Late Medieval transport/trade-ship definitions and expanded maritime capacity. Escort remains a military assignment, not automatic immunity.

name: Naval Gunnery
description: Cannon-armed Late Medieval warship and naval-ordnance capability. Powder supply is an operational input question, not an Economic research prerequisite.

name: Broadside Tactics
description: Improved naval gunnery/reload and formation handling. Port/starboard art supports a proposed broadside profile; firing arcs must be domain-defined.

name: Steel Equipment
description: Late Medieval blacksmith and barracks, plate swordsmen and shared Late Medieval equipment manufactured from steel. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Crossbows and Field Guns
description: Crossbowmen use shared Late Medieval equipment. Organ Guns and Bombards use shared Late Medieval siege equipment made from steel and gunpowder. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Lance Knights
description: Knight stables and lance cavalry. Recruitment uses shared Late Medieval equipment, horses and reserves. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Siege Ordnance
description: Stronger towers, walls and gates, siege workshops and Bombards. Bombards use shared Late Medieval siege equipment. Handheld firearm infantry starts in Early Modern. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Steelmaking
description: Carbon/fuel raw extraction as authored, steel refining, and Late Medieval mine/factory tier. No mineable steel deposit.

name: Powder Milling
description: Unlock direct gunpowder extraction from deposits using mines, supplying shared Late Medieval siege equipment. No ingredient refining is needed. Handheld firearm infantry starts in Early Modern.

name: Guild Commerce
description: Late Medieval city/commercial production tier, three covered-wagon trader, and cobblestone roads.

name: Urban Administration
description: Higher commercial load capacity, reserve administration, and producer handling efficiency.

name: Ocean Navigation
description: Early Modern port/hull tier and improved maritime navigation performance; no arbitrary global teleportation. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Ocean Transport
description: Early Modern ocean transport and merchant-ship definitions, larger legal load capacity.

name: Ships of the Line
description: Early Modern gun warship definition and its gunnery capability.

name: Fleet Coordination
description: Better fleet handling, loading and gunnery coordination under explicit combat values.

name: Firearms
description: Armory, Early Modern barracks and short-gun infantry. Manufacture shared Early Modern equipment from iron and gunpowder for frontline, ranged and mounted troops. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Musket and Artillery Drill
description: Musketeers use shared Early Modern equipment. Field cannons and howitzers use shared Early Modern siege equipment, with distinct research and attack profiles. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Pistoliers
description: Early Modern stables and mounted pistoliers. Recruitment uses shared Early Modern equipment, horses and reserves. Mounted firearms do not inherit melee charge. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Howitzer Engineering
description: Gunpowder-era fortifications, Early Modern siege foundry and Early Howitzer equipment/definition, separate from the field cannon. Keep material/weapon requirements separate from research. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Powder Manufactories
description: Higher-volume powder/refining recipes and Early Modern mine/factory tier; builds on Late Medieval powder capability.

name: Manufactories
description: Early Modern city/commercial factory tier and improved production throughput. Shared infrastructure still separates commercial batches and strategic jobs.

name: Long-Distance Commerce
description: Four-wagon trader, dressed-stone roads, and improved finite route capacity/handling. Foreign/allied commerce already exists and is not gated here.

name: Military Provisioning
description: Better equipment-production handling and stable breeding/logistics; larger supported deliveries without unbounded free trader creation.

name: Powered Vessels
description: Modern port and powered hull-production tier. Fuel/ship recipes require separate authoring. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Amphibious Transport
description: Modern transport and container trade ship; authored transport capacity for heavier definitions such as tanks. No aircraft-carrier mechanics are inferred.

name: Modern Warships
description: Modern warship and naval gunnery; map its actual art to a combat definition rather than simply boosting a canoe's DPS.

name: Fleet Operations
description: Final naval handling/capacity/combat coordination tier. Sensors/anti-air behaviour require explicit combat/visibility contracts before being advertised.

name: Modern Armaments
description: Arms Factory, Modern barracks and rifle infantry. Manufacture shared Modern equipment for rifle infantry, marksmen and machine-gun crews. Older researched equipment recipes remain available. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Combined Arms
description: Marksmen, machine-gun crews, tanks, vehicle depots, howitzers and anti-air vehicles. Manufacture shared Modern siege and vehicle equipment. Tanks and other ground vehicles require one of each; howitzers require siege equipment. Gun nests and trenches replace the new wall tier. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Military Aviation
description: Military Airstrips, fighters and bombers. Aircraft require gold and build time only, with no equipment, materials or reserve-troop cost. Airfield capacity and aviation research still apply. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Strategic Weapons
description: Missile silos, fixed MIRV launchers, mobile MIRV launchers and strategic payload production. Mobile launchers require shared Modern siege and vehicle equipment. Payloads are manufactured separately and consumed when launched. Unlocks paid, one-tier upgrades for compatible existing buildings; select them and press U.

name: Petroleum Extraction
description: Oil deposits and late offshore Oil Rigs. Proposed onshore extraction uses the existing Oil Well art under this same node; placement/ownership must be explicit.

name: Industrial Production
description: Modern city/factory/mine tier, higher existing-material refining/commercial output, and improved production throughput. No new obligatory metal.

name: Motor Freight
description: Modern civilian freight-truck trader and asphalt roads with larger finite load. Free factory dispatch does not silently deduct horses, oil or a military weapon kit.

name: Integrated Logistics
description: Highest proposed production/load-handling tier and final horse-breeding improvement on retained eligible horse stables. Modern vehicle-depot art is not a new horse-breeding building.
